_comment: Every value here corresponds to Table 4 of the paper and to the constants in src/run_final_v2.py and src/run_reve_baseline.py. Edit paths.dataset_root before running anything.

paths._note: Folder holding the BCIC2020-IV Track 3 data and the stored intermediate files: prep_stage1_final_robust/ (Stage-1 tensors and GLOBAL_stage1final_summary.csv) and INASS_REVISION_FINAL/stage2_MDRG_corrected/npz/ (Stage-2 feature matrices). The REVE baseline reads the original 'Training set', 'Validation set' and 'Test set' MATLAB files (any folder whose name contains training set, validation set or test/testing set) from the same folder.

protocol.validation_role: selects raw-branch architecture, seed and stopping epoch; MDRG feature subset, classifier family and regularisation constant; the fusion weight; the graph-comparator configuration
protocol.refit_before_test: each selected configuration is refit on train + validation (350 trials; 347 for participant 14). The raw branch is refit for exactly the selected number of epochs with the cosine schedule set to that length. The fusion weight is not re-selected.
protocol.test_role: scored once per system; test labels are passed only to the metric routines and to the file that stores posteriors for the statistics

stage1_signal_conditioning.channel_normalisation: z-score per channel, statistics from the training split only

stage1_quality_control.train_policy: hybrid: remove severe trials, winsorise the remainder
stage1_quality_control.outcome: 3 of 4500 training trials removed, all participant 14, class 'yes'; see artifacts/stage1_qc_audit.csv

stage2_mdrg.windows: disjoint partition of the 513-sample segment: early [0, 1000) ms = 256 samples (j = 0..255); late [1000, 2000] ms = 257 samples (j = 256..512); overlap 0
stage2_mdrg.tangent_reference: log-Euclidean mean over training trials, per band and window
stage2_mdrg.tangent_vectorisation: upper triangle, off-diagonal scaled by sqrt(2), 171 coefficients
stage2_mdrg.graph_descriptors: 6 smallest normalised-Laplacian eigenvalues of the PLV graph + mean degree, degree SD, spectral entropy = 9
stage2_mdrg.feature_repair: none: zero non-finite entries in every split of every participant; no column imputed, clipped or removed

eegconformerlite.encoder: 2 x TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=64, nhead=4, dim_feedforward=192, GELU, pre-norm, dropout 0.30)
eegconformerlite.head: mean over time + LayerNorm(64) + Linear(64,5)

raw_branch.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR, T_max = 90 during selection, = selected epoch count at refit
raw_branch.early_stopping: macro-F1 on the official validation split, patience 15

mdrg_branch.readout: standardised shallow probabilistic classifier on a selected feature subset (no neural network)
mdrg_branch.standardisation: z-score per column; fitted on training trials during selection and on train + validation at refit
mdrg_branch.selection_metric: macro-F1 on the official validation split

fusion.selected_on: validation posteriors of the models fitted on the training split
fusion.applied_to: test posteriors of the refit models, omega unchanged
fusion.note: One scalar shared across all five classes; no temperature scaling

graph_comparator.affinity: RBF on standardised views, exp(-gamma * mean squared difference)
graph_comparator.consensus: non-negative view weights summing to one, simplex grid step 0.25 (15 weight vectors)
graph_comparator.decision: affinity-weighted vote among the k most similar fitting trials
graph_comparator.selection_metric: macro-F1 on the official validation split
graph_comparator.note: Adaptation of the multi-view consensus-graph principle of Zhao et al. [15], not a reproduction.

ablation.selection: validation split, per variant and participant

statistics.test: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank across the 15 participants; zero differences discarded
statistics.holm_family: five macro-F1 comparisons against the proposed fusion on the test split
